source(output(
		lead_created_date as string,
		external_patient_id as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource

		lead_date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SBSB_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		lead_date = lead_created_date,
		SBSB_ID = external_patient_id)) ~> OLEDBDestination
